from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, tomllib

repo = Path('/home/codex/.codex/worktrees/46be/Proofs')
overlay = Path('/tmp/object-current-overlay.txt').read_text().strip()
overlay = Path(overlay)
cfg = tomllib.loads((repo / 'lakefile.toml').read_text())
roots = [repo / x.get('srcDir', '.') for x in cfg['lean_lib']]
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
seen = {}
def visit(mod):
    if mod in seen:
        return
    candidates = [r / (mod.replace('.', '/') + '.lean') for r in roots]
    found = [p for p in candidates if p.exists()]
    if not found:
        return
    p = found[0]
    imports = []
    for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'\s*(?:public\s+)?import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)', line)
        if m:
            imports.append(m[1])
    seen[mod] = {'module': mod, 'source': str(p), 'source_sha256': sha(p), 'imports': imports}
    for dep in imports:
        visit(dep)
visit('DiophantineConsistency.CurrentPolynomialWindow2011')
for mod, row in seen.items():
    src = repo / '.lake/build/lib/lean' / (mod.replace('.', '/') + '.olean')
    if not src.exists():
        row['mode'] = 'current-source-closure-gap-not-used-by-accepted-object-imports'
        continue
    dest = overlay / (mod.replace('.', '/') + '.olean')
    row.update(object=str(src), object_sha256=sha(src),
               mode='reused-previously-accepted-native-object-no-current-source-rebuild-claim')
    if not dest.exists():
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest.symlink_to(src)
    else:
        row['private_object_already_present'] = True
Path('/tmp/object-current-native-reuse.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(seen.values()), indent=2) + '\n')
print('Recorded existing native closure:', len(seen), 'modules; no shared objects changed.')
